---
title: "Senators"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
library(reactable)
source("scripts/shared.R")

# Pull any newly uploaded role profiles before deciding whether the
# Profile column appears
sync_intake_profiles()

senators <- load_senators() |>
  mutate(display_name = paste(Last.Name, First.Name, sep = ", ")) |>
  arrange(District)

# Profile links are PER SENATOR: profiles arrive one upload at a time,
# so each row links only when its own PDF exists (filenames follow
# name_link: e.g. ochoa_bogh_19_profile.pdf). The column appears once
# anyone has posted one.
profile_files <- sprintf("%s_%s_profile.pdf", senators$name_link, senators$District)
has_profile   <- file.exists(file.path(SEN_PROFILE_DIR, profile_files))

# The Leadership column carries floor leadership AND committee chairships,
# in the senator pages' own style ("Chair, Appropriations"). Plain text goes
# in the column (so sorting and the search box see real words); the linked
# version is drawn by the cell renderer below.
role_text <- character(nrow(senators))
role_html <- character(nrow(senators))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(senators))) {
  s <- senators[i, ]
  txt <- character(0); html <- character(0)
  if (!is.na(s$Leadership) && s$Leadership != "") {
    txt  <- s$Leadership
    html <- sprintf('<a href="%s">%s</a>', leadership_url(),
                    htmltools::htmlEscape(s$Leadership))
  }
  for (role in c("Chair", "Vice Chair")) {
    code <- if (role == "Chair") s$Chair else s$Vice.Chair
    if (!is.na(code) && code != "") {
      nm <- unname(COMMITTEE_NAMES[code])
      if (is.na(nm)) nm <- toupper(code)
      txt  <- c(txt, paste0(role, ", ", nm))
      # Chairships link to that committee's tab, floor roles to #leadership
      html <- c(html, sprintf('<a href="%s">%s, %s</a>', committee_url(code),
                              role, htmltools::htmlEscape(nm)))
    }
  }
  role_text[i] <- paste(txt, collapse = " · ")
  role_html[i] <- paste(html, collapse = " &middot; ")
}
leadership_has_data <- any(role_text != "")

tbl <- senators |> select(District, display_name, Party)
if (leadership_has_data) tbl$Leadership <- role_text

# Fundraising: each senator's progress toward their goal, as a bar that
# fills as contributions arrive (campaign finance; see shared.R)
fin <- senator_finance(senators)
tbl$Fundraising <- fin$Pct[match(senators$District, fin$District)]
if (any(has_profile)) {
  tbl$Profile <- ifelse(has_profile,
                        file.path(SEN_PROFILE_DIR, profile_files),
                        NA_character_)
}

cols <- list(
  # numeric: sorts 1, 2, … 40; links to the Districts map zoomed to it
  District = colDef(width = 90,
    cell = link_cell("", sprintf("map.html?district=%s", senators$District))),
  display_name = colDef(
    name = "Name",
    cell = link_cell("", sprintf("%s/district_%s.html", SENATOR_PAGES_DIR, senators$District))
  ),
  Party = colDef(width = 70),
  Fundraising = colDef(width = 150, html = TRUE,
    cell = function(value) progress_bar_html(value))
)
if (leadership_has_data) {
  cols$Leadership <- colDef(html = TRUE,
                            cell = function(value, index) role_html[index])
}
if (any(has_profile)) {
  cols$Profile <- colDef(
    sortable = FALSE, width = 110,
    cell = function(value) {
      if (is.na(value)) "" else htmltools::tags$a(href = value, "View Profile")
    }
  )
}

legsim_table(tbl, page_size = 20, columns = cols)
```

<p class="table-note">A note for students: you are role-playing real,
sitting senators. Anything you create for the simulation outside this
site — social-media accounts, posts, press releases, anything public —
must be clearly marked as fictional UC Merced simulation work, so it can
never be mistaken for the real senator.</p>
